title: APF 2K8 closed uniform texture format specification

scope.spec_boundary: exact fixed-allocation texture transport; not a general APF TXTR or mesh specification

h7a_format.byte_order: big-endian header and big-endian 16-bit match words
h7a_format.flag_order: one descriptor byte, least-significant bit first, up to 8 tokens
h7a_format.output_rule: decode exactly declared uncompressed length; reject overrun, underrun, or nonzero trailing compressed bytes
h7a_format.rebuild_rule: preserve each retail block shift and codec field; require encode-decode exact before IFF rebuild

operation_order_encode: swap bytes within each 16-bit word for endianness mode 1
operation_order_decode: swap bytes within each 16-bit word for endianness mode 1
xenos_transport.packed_tail_origin_rule: Xenia GetPackedTileOffset; origins in 4x4 compression blocks
xenos_transport.endianness_mode_1: 8-in-16: reverse each two-byte unit; operation is self-inverse

related_resources_must_remain_exact: all bytes outside selected outer allocation

png_input_contract.channel_rule: RGBA supplies BC3 color and alpha

known_unknowns: BC3 alpha, asymmetric UV orientation, fine-detail, and distant-mip runtime fidelity are not generalized by the solid-color asset-6 witness.
The deterministic encoder is not a production perceptual BC3 backend.
Arbitrary detailed images may exceed a slot's H7A-compressed fixed allocation and must be refused.
Selector rewriting and all-team de-aliasing are separate unproved formats.

related_resources_must_remain_exact: all bytes outside selected outer allocation

codec.stored_channels: raw R and G data channels

png_input_contract.channel_rule: R and G are raw DXN channels; every B byte must be 0; shader meanings unknown

known_unknowns: The shader meanings and composition of helmet_color R and G are not proved; they remain raw data channels.
No changed helmet_color asset has a Xenia or Xbox 360 hardware runtime witness.
The deterministic paired-BC4 encoder is not a production perceptual DXN backend.
Arbitrary images may exceed a slot's H7A-compressed fixed allocation and must be refused.
Selector rewriting and per-team de-aliasing are separate unproved formats.

related_resources_must_remain_exact: all bytes outside selected outer allocation

png_input_contract.channel_rule: RGB encoded as opaque four-color BC1; transparency rejected

known_unknowns: No changed pants_color asset has a Xenia or Xbox 360 hardware runtime witness.
The deterministic encoder is not a production perceptual BC1 backend.
Arbitrary detailed images may exceed a slot's H7A-compressed fixed allocation and must be refused.
The three DXN normal maps are preserved but not editable through this family contract.
Selector rewriting and per-team de-aliasing are separate unproved formats.

global_known_unknowns: IFF block-descriptor field +0x08 is structurally pinned but its semantic name is unknown.
H7A is closed for the observed decode/encode class, but the retail compressor's optimization strategy is not claimed to be reproduced.
The raw Xenos swizzle value 1672 and components [0,1,2,3] are pinned; shader-level interpretation beyond each family contract is not inferred.
This v1 specification excludes shoulder_color because its all-24 proof was still in flight when the three-family closure was frozen.
This is not a mesh, skeleton, attachment, material-binding, or general IFF specification.
